standard.summary: observe/planner 不改变训练 tensor 路径
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: observe/planner do not change the training tensor path
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: observe/planner 不改变训练 tensor 路径；cache_observe 会接入候选统计；cache_v0 才会按预算尝试 GPU 解码缓存，建议只在监控显示 PCIe 等待明显时手动 。

advanced_en.principle: observe/planner do not change the training tensor path; cache_observe hooks into candidate statistics; only cache_v0 actually attempts GPU decode caching against a budget — enable it manually only when monitoring shows noticeable PCIe waits.
